definitions.explanation: A woodwind instrument held vertically and blown from the top end. In modern Japanese, most commonly refers to the plastic recorder used in school music classes.

examples.japanese: {縦笛|たてぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{縦笛|たてぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned the recorder in elementary school music class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{縦笛|たてぶえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きて⟦{懐|なつ}かしく→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The recorder I used as a child turned up in a drawer and made me feel nostalgic.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical) and {笛|ぶえ} (flute), contrasting with ⟦{横笛|よこぶえ}→横笛：22502_yokobue⟧ (transverse flute, held horizontally). In everyday usage, almost always refers to the plastic soprano recorder (⟦リコーダー→リコーダー：28505_rikoodaa⟧) that is standard equipment in Japanese elementary school music education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦笛|たてぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to play the recorder
- {縦笛|たてぶえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: recorder practice
- ソプラノ{縦笛|たてぶえ}: soprano recorder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リコーダー→リコーダー：28505_rikoodaa⟧: recorder (loanword) — the more common modern term for the plastic school instrument
- ⟦{横笛|よこぶえ}→横笛：22502_yokobue⟧: transverse flute — held sideways; includes Western flutes and traditional Japanese ⟦{篠笛|しのぶえ}→篠笛：28761_shinobue⟧
- ⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧: flute/whistle — generic term for any wind instrument of this type
